title: API Lifecycle
description: The lifecycle status of the API

status.description:
The lifecycle status of the API, derived from the `deprecated` and `sunset` dates:

- `active`: the API is supported and may still be developed further.
- `deprecated`: the `deprecated` date has passed. The API can still be used, but is no longer supported or developed further. Consumers should migrate.
- `sunset`: the API is being phased out and will be taken offline on the `sunset` date, which lies in the future.
- `retired`: the `sunset` date has passed. The API is offline and can no longer be used.

deprecated.description: The date from which the API is no longer supported or developed further. Until this date the status is `active`.

sunset.description: The date from which the API is taken offline. After this date the status is `retired`.
